name: alshival-local
description: Manage workspaces in the standalone Alshival desktop app on this computer.

interface.longDescription: Manage tasks, notes, boards, resources, and local monitoring through the Alshival desktop app on this computer. Requires the installed Windows or Linux app and a running local service. No portal account is required. Local access uses your desktop user's permissions; read-only setup is available. Portal synchronization is configured separately in the app. Use the Alshival portal plugin for direct team access through OAuth.
